clips.title: The story
paras: Soft Saber Pelts represents a trade agreement aimed at keeping wilderness roads secure from predatory cats. Hunters bring in the thick furs of local sabers so they can be crafted into warm, protective blankets and shawls.

Traversing the untamed paths of Azeroth requires constant vigilance against prowling predators. Large sabers frequently roam near well-traveled thoroughfares, presenting a persistent hazard to couriers, merchants, and lone adventurers. While local inhabitants admire the grace and majesty of these great cats, allowing their numbers to swell unchecked along trade routes invites deadly ambushes. Gathering hunters to keep the local roads safe serves as a necessary measure for communal survival.

Hunting such impressive beasts is not done merely for sport or eradication. In frontier encampments, every resource is valued, and the dense, velvety coats of wild sabers are prized for their warmth and durability. Once brought in by capable hunters, the pelts are tailored into fine shawls and heavy blankets capable of fending off harsh weather, ensuring that nothing taken from the wild goes to waste.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.

I'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, these are wonderful. It is a shame to resort to violence with such majestic animals, but it is important to keep the roads safe, and these pelts will make beautiful blankets and shawls.
Here, let me give you something to remember them. It is both soft and sturdy.
